services.name: Balloon Pin
services.desc: Hot air balloon pins are a fun way to take your adventure home with you! Pin one on your backpack, shirt or memory board to forever commemorate your time among the clouds. These pins measure 1.25” tall and portray the very same saguaro cactus artwork found on actual hot air balloons within our fleet. As we have many balloons in our fleet, color schemes may vary. Shipping Disclaimer: We can only ship to addresses within the United States. Please allow 5-7 business days for delivery. blurb: Guests experience a hot air balloon ride over the Sonoran Desert, including viewing the balloon inflation, a 45-60 minute flight, a post-flight champagne toast, catered cuisine, and commemorative flight certificates. Rides are available daily year-round in Phoenix and Tucson, with seasonal afternoon rides in Phoenix. The total tour time is 3-3.5 hours from check-in or 4-4.5 hours with roundtrip hotel transportation.
